house.description: Sale of food with certain artificial dyes prohibited.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Commerce Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to commerce; prohibiting the sale of food with certain artificial dyes; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 325F.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[325F.079] PROHIBITION OF ARTIFICIAL FOOD DYES. +]

[+A person is prohibited from knowingly selling, offering to sell, or distributing food or food products that contain the following artificial dyes: +]

[+(1) Red 3; +]

[+(2) Red 40; +]

[+(3) Yellow 5; +]

[+(4) Yellow 6; +]

[+(5) Blue 1; +]

[+(6) Blue 2; or +]

[+(7) Green 3. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective January 1, 2026. +]
